subtopic: Schedule II and III quantity limits
stem: Before the next dispensing, a pharmacist evaluates a phendimetrazine prescription. Select all rules that may apply.

choices.text: Given the described event, schedule III status permits unlimited refills for phendimetrazine.

related_facts: phendimetrazine (Bontril) is used for short-term adjunct in a weight-reduction regimen; it is federal Schedule III and Massachusetts Schedule III.

Massachusetts generally limits Schedule II and III opioid prescriptions to a 30-day supply and recognizes defined 90-day pathways for OUD drugs, non-opioid Schedule II or III drugs, and implantable infusion pumps.
A Schedule III or IV prescription may not be filled or refilled more than six months after issue and may not be refilled more than five times unless renewed by the practitioner.
